name: sherpa
description: Sherpa : console interne de déploiement et d'administration Docker (hôtes joints en SSH ou par agent Portainer)

scripts.deps:up: docker compose -f compose.dev.yml up -d --wait postgres redis
scripts.deps:down: docker compose -f compose.dev.yml stop postgres redis
scripts.build:runner: esbuild runner/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/runner.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.stack:up: sh -c 'docker network inspect platform-edge >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create platform-edge >/dev/null; docker compose -f compose.dev.yml up -d --build --wait'
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose -f compose.dev.yml logs -f app worker runner
scripts.dev:export-ca: sh -c 'mkdir -p .data/ca && security find-certificate -c "${CA_NAME:-SCEPman-Root-CA-V1}" -p /Library/Keychains/System.keychain > .data/ca/internal-ca.pem && echo AC exportée dans .data/ca/internal-ca.pem'
scripts.dev:export-runtime-ca: sh -c 'mkdir -p .data/ca && : > .data/ca/runtime-ca.pem; IFS=,; for n in ${RUNTIME_CA_NAMES:-SCEPman-Root-CA-V1,Zscaler Root CA}; do security find-certificate -a -c "$n" -p /Library/Keychains/System.keychain >> .data/ca/runtime-ca.pem 2>/dev/null && echo "AC « $n » ajoutée"; done; echo "$(grep -c BEGIN .data/ca/runtime-ca.pem) certificat(s) dans .data/ca/runtime-ca.pem (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS des conteneurs)"'
